edges.reason: owner is assigned directly from tx.origin in the GEM constructor, making ownership dependent on the transaction origin.
tx.origin is read in the constructor to seed owner and to grant an infinite allowance.
msg.sender controls the allowance branch and selects which allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
msg.sender is compared against owner to authorise the delegatecall.
msg.sender is compared against owner to authorise distribute.
msg.sender is compared against owner to authorise list and also receives a fixed balance.
msg.sender is the owner key of the allowance mapping written by approve.
msg.sender becomes the _from argument when transfer forwards to transferFrom.
block.timestamp is used to build the router deadline (block.timestamp + 600), creating timestamp dependency.
The miner-influenced timestamp flows into the deadline argument of addLiquidityETH.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates the arbitrary delegatecall.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates the bulk balance overwrite in distribute.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates the liquidity listing and balance overwrite in list.
